data.age: Age of Discovery, after the Age of Renaissance

title: Al-Andalus claims the title of Cultural Hegemon as the renewed Andalusī golden age continues

The New World institution appears in the world, and its origin is Ishbīliya. No new world has been found yet, but the culture of exploration and expeditions, backed by the crown, has taken root in the capital

data.state: treasury 1,750, 3.246 million people, stability 21; Ishbīliya, Barcelona and Lisbon each the first market of their region

title: Khālid ibn Abī Ḥammū comes of age at sixteen and takes the Ṭāʾifa of Burghush into his own hands, ending the Emperor's regency
Bernarda of Murcia, widow of the Emperor Ismāʿīl and mother of the Emperor Muḥammad, dies of old age at seventy
